_format: skill-creator eval format. Run each prompt in a fresh session with and without the skill; grade the assertions. expect_trigger false = must not load; null = output-quality only.

evals.prompt: Our site works on the apex but https://www.ourclub.dev just hangs and then shows a Cloudflare 522 page. The site deploys with wrangler as a static-assets Worker. What's wrong?
assertions: Explains that the proxied www record has no claimant (no Worker route, custom domain or redirect rule), so Cloudflare forwards to the record's origin, which never answers
Recommends a 301 single redirect rule from www to the apex that preserves the path, rather than routing the Worker on www too
Mentions checking or replacing the placeholder origin with 192.0.2.1 or 100:: rather than a parking or registrar IP
Offers a verification step such as edge_check.py live or a curl on both hostnames

evals.prompt: I have a static Astro marketing site for my company. Set it up to deploy on Cloudflare for free from our Forgejo CI.
assertions: Chooses Workers static assets (assets-only Worker, no main) over Cloudflare Pages for a new project
Config sets workers_dev and preview_urls explicitly, a route or custom domain for the hostname, and not_found_handling 404-page
CI uses CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID with a token scoped to Workers Scripts Edit plus Workers Routes Edit on the zone, and a pinned wrangler
Includes a post-deploy smoke test that waits for the edge and checks a real 404
Does not recommend Vercel Hobby, which forbids commercial use

evals.prompt:
Review this wrangler.toml before I merge:

name = "site"
main = "src/index.ts"
compatibility_date = "2026-09-26"
workers_dev = true
routes = [{ pattern = "example.org/*", zone_name = "example.org" }]

[[d1_databases]]
binding = "DB"
database_id = "df25762e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

[env.staging]
name = "site-staging"
routes = [{ pattern = "staging.example.org/*", zone_name = "example.org" }]

[[env.staging.d1_databases]]
binding = "DB"
database_id = "df25762e-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
assertions: Flags that staging and production share one D1 database, so staging reads and writes production data
Flags workers_dev = true alongside routes as an extra public workers.dev hostname outside zone rules and hostname Access
Notes that preview_urls is unset
Runs or recommends edge_check.py config on the file

evals.prompt: I want to send a client a one-page HTML proposal that only they can open, and that stops working after 30 days. We already have our domain on Cloudflare. How?
assertions: Uses a Worker plus KV plus a per-page Cloudflare Access application with an Allow policy for the recipient's email and one-time PIN login
Creates the Access gate before uploading the content, and has the Worker validate the Access JWT so a missing gate fails closed
Disables or protects workers.dev and preview URLs so the page has no side door
Explains the 50-seat free limit, that each recipient holds a seat until removed, and to enable automatic removal of inactive users
Warns that the recipient must be on the policy before requesting a code, because Cloudflare sends codes only to allowed addresses while showing the same screen

evals.prompt: A Dutch client insists their marketing site be hosted by an EU-owned company, no US hyperscalers or Cloudflare. Budget is near zero. What do you recommend?
assertions: Recommends an EU-owned option such as Bunny.net, statichost.eu or Scaleway with its trade-off
Notes that Cloudflare's EU data localization is Enterprise-only and so doesn't meet the requirement on a free plan
States the cost or overage behaviour of the recommendation (prepaid, hard stop, or bill)
